title: The Last Thorn Anew
author: C. M. Delacroix
blurb: Dominic Whitlock, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
